The '''''Cardan II''-class space station''' was the second model of [[Cardan-class space station|''Cardan''-class]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]] built for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. These stations were nearly identical to the [[Cardan I-class space station|''Cardan I''-class]] but added a vertical section attached to the bottom of the space station which provided more space for weapon emplacements and [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] construction bays.

==History==
These stations supplemented the ''Cardan I''-class due to those predecessors' relatively poor defensive systems. ''Cardan II''-class stations were placed in areas of moderate importance but nonetheless could still be overwhelmed by a small force of [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]] and [[Frigate/Legends|frigates]].

==Armament==
The ''Cardan II'' was more able to defend itself due to more room and power for additional weapons. It carried three light [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolaser]] batteries, three point-defense light [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]] batteries, two [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedo]] launchers, and two [[Tractor beam/Legends|tractor beam]] projectors. It also had more hangar space than its forebear, and could hold twenty-four [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Each station could also hold four shuttles

==Usage==
The ''Cardan II'' supplemented older models, and was sometimes seen accompanied by starships up to 650 meters long.

==Construction options==
The ''Cardan II'' could retain its predecessor's capabilities whilst opening up new possibilities to construct [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]]. The expanded bays of the improved station could construct two new TIE models: the [[TIE/sr starfighter]] and, potentially, the [[TIE/ph "Phantom" Multi-Role Stealth Starfighter/Legends|TIE Phantom]], although no station actually built these. The larger construction bays allowed for more independence from more large-scale shipyards such as Kuat. Two classes of patrol vessels were taken into consideration when [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]] began plans for expanding the [[Cardan I-class space station|''Cardan I''-class space station]]. The [[Tartan-class patrol cruiser|''Tartan''-class patrol cruiser]] was the first option, with the second being the more-or-less outdated [[Acclamator II-class assault ship/Legends|''Acclamator II''-class assault ship]].
